rows: D-JSCC wildfire detection from UAV aerial imagery, reconstruction skipped for fast inference, and accuracy depends on the altitude of UAVs.

Under time slots experience deep fading, structural information is prioritized transmitted, receiver employs conditional generative prior to hallucinate missing textures, 5.6 dB PSNR gain over D-JSCC.

Context-adaptive digital from ground user to base station is proposed, where the UAV acts as a relay layer and is required to optimize trajectory and the associated user; up to 22% SSS gain and 14% AoI reduction.
Multi-scale codec + Relational Graph Attention Network

Triple-based scene graph to determine user preference image

Only transmit the interested image of the user instead of all sensing images obtained by UAV. The interested image is determined by the user’s triplet, which helps the author derive a semantic encoder.
Four agents jointly optimize the UAV trajectory, the number of semantic symbols, and the UAV transmit power for image gathering.
K-means clustering to determine a set of served users for UAV

Improved from the scenario [182], consider an UAV to serve multiple users in a shared spectrum resource, where the author adopted NOMA for spectrum utilization. UAV trajectory, symbols, and power are optimized.

The study focuses on the current trend in the low-altitude economy, where multiple UAVs collaboratively collect data, perform semantic forwarding, act as a virtual antenna array for beamforming to communicate with BS.
Gurobi solvers for user associate, Ant colony for UAV trajectory

The paper studies the integration of SemCom with fluid antenna, where UAV optimizes trajectory, transmit covariance matrix, compression rate, and port selection for image users equipped with the fluid antenna.
Distributed SemCom, jointly optimize trajectory & bandwidth

UAV as the central coordinator for distributed SemCom learning devices, where edge intelligence is leveraged to handle computation tasks due to D-JSCC nature, and reduce the burden on resource-constrained UAVs.

LEO satellite conduct SemCom toward HAP, where to facilitate the complex requirement of QoSem, the semantic information, transmit power, communication, and computation resources are jointly optimized.
